headline: Photos Behind Kennedy Center Tarps Show No Sign of Trump’s Name
context: Images circulated by an activist group reveal bare marble where President Trump’s name once resided. The Kennedy Center previously told a federal judge it had been removed.

sources.name: The New York Times
